existing_record_upgrade.finding: Training/test mass-light orientation and ellipticity correlations were explicitly manipulated; mismatches alter inference, with weaker effects on Einstein radius than orientation/ellipticity.

added_records.title: Lens Model Accuracy in the Expected LSST Lensed AGN Sample
added_records.dataset_and_design: NPE on LSST-like lensed AGN; regenerate training without mass-light ellipticity correlations.
added_records.supported_finding: Correlation removal changes parameter recovery; matched correlations can improve inference.
added_records.main_limitation: Different target vector and inference framework; correlations may be informative priors, not universally invalid shortcuts.
added_records.project_implication: Direction 1 must exceed a correlated/decorrelated comparison and test when decorrelation is harmful.
added_records.sections_assessed: Sections IV.4 and V.1; selected full-text
added_records.report_family_note: Preprint and published report treated as one work where applicable

added_records.title: Underspecification Presents Challenges for Credibility in Modern Machine Learning
added_records.dataset_and_design: Validation-equivalent models from pipelines differing in random seed; application-specific stress tests.
added_records.supported_finding: Similar in-domain performance can conceal different shortcut reliance and shifted behavior.
added_records.main_limitation: General ML evidence, not a lens-specific mechanism.
added_records.project_implication: Direction 2 alone is a domain replication; add prospective physical failure prediction.
added_records.sections_assessed: Full-text protocol and shortcut/seed passages; selected full-text
added_records.report_family_note: Preprint and published report treated as one work where applicable

added_records.title: Selecting Data Augmentation for Simulating Interventions
added_records.dataset_and_design: Causal perspective and augmentation-selection algorithm for domain generalization.
added_records.supported_finding: Augmentation can simulate interventions that weaken spurious associations.
added_records.main_limitation: Does not establish foreground obscuration controls in lens regression.
added_records.project_implication: Causal augmentation selection is prior art.
